text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigeria has generated six billion naira from Value Added Tax for the months of January and February compared to 4.4 billion naira in the corresponding period in 1996.
- Britain, a leading trading partner with Nigeria, may ban importation of non-oil products from the African country due to poor quality of goods, newspaper says, quoting own investigation.

- Western sanctions on Nigeria have not promoted the right business environment needed by the oil multinational Mobil Corp, Paul Hoenmans, the company's vice-president tells an economic workshop in the capital Abuja.

- Nigerian security agents detain a Lagos-based businesswoman for possessing seditious materials belonging to the environmental campaign group "Ogoni People's Front" and the pro-democracy Campaign for Democracy group.
